issue.title: Elevar el predicado de join en schema.relations
issue.description:
## User Story

As a **migration engineer**, I want the COBOL parser to lift JOIN predicates so that the
translated query keeps its filters.

## Context

The pilot closed with 26 NOT_APPLICABLE results, every one of them a JOIN whose predicate was
dropped on transcription.

## Scope

The COBOL parser's JOIN path only.

**Out of scope:** the Qlik reader — tracked in the spec at https://example.invalid/spec

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The predicate is lifted onto the JOIN.

## Technical Notes

The mapper needs the same change.

## Definition of Done

- The regression test passes.
- The corpus does not regress.
